# Cub Scout Adventures

Cub Scouts earn Adventures that are specific to their grade and rank. A number
of Adventures must be completed to earn the badge of rank for each grade
level. Completion of Adventures is how the aims of character, citizenship,
leadership, and personal fitness are developed.

# Cub Scout Adventures

Cub Scouts earn Adventures that are specific to their grade and rank. A number
of Adventures must be completed to earn the badge of rank for each grade
level. Completion of Adventures is how the aims of character, citizenship,
leadership, and personal fitness are developed.
